meaning.en: To wander here and there with no purpose or proper occupation.
meaning.zh: 到处闲逛，不做正事。

examples.zh: 他毕业后一直东游西荡，没找一份正经工作。
examples.en: Since graduating he has just drifted about without finding a proper job.

examples.zh: 放假了，孩子们整天在村里东游西荡。
examples.en: On holiday the children roam the village all day with nothing to do.

examples.zh: 别再东游西荡了，赶快回去复习功课。
examples.en: Stop idling about and go back to revise your lessons.

usage.en: Predicate; disapproving and colloquial.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，带贬义，口语色彩较强。

meaning.en: Guests arrive in great numbers; a very lively gathering.
meaning.zh: 来的客人很多，像天上的云那样多。

examples.zh: 婚礼现场宾客如云，热闹非凡。
examples.en: The wedding was packed with guests and wonderfully lively.

examples.zh: 新店开业那天，门前宾客如云。
examples.en: On the day the new shop opened, guests crowded the entrance.

examples.zh: 他家的寿宴上宾客如云，连邻村的人都来了。
examples.en: His birthday banquet was thronged with guests, even people from the next village came.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; used for weddings, banquets and openings.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，用于婚宴、寿宴、开业等场合。

natural: hide by day and move at night

meaning.en: To stay hidden in the daytime and come out at night, as nocturnal animals do or as fugitives and thieves do.
meaning.zh: 白天隐藏起来，夜里出来活动。

equivalents: lie low by day and move by night

examples.zh: 猫头鹰昼伏夜行，白天很难见到。
examples.en: Owls are nocturnal, so it is hard to see them in the daytime.

examples.zh: 逃犯昼伏夜行，躲了半个多月。
examples.en: The fugitive hid by day and travelled by night for over two weeks.

examples.zh: 游击队昼伏夜行，避开了敌人的搜捕。
examples.en: The guerrillas lay low by day and moved at night to avoid the enemy's search.

usage.en: Predicate; neutral for animals, often suspicious when said of people.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；用于动物时中性，用于人时常带有躲藏的意味。

meaning.en: To have one's own original style or ideas in writing and creative work, rather than imitating others.
meaning.zh: 比喻诗文的构思和布局有独创的风格，不模仿别人。

examples.zh: 这位作家的小说自出机杼，风格独特。
examples.en: This writer's novels are wholly original, with a distinctive style.

examples.zh: 设计师自出机杼，做出了与众不同的作品。
examples.en: The designer worked out something of her own and made a truly different piece.

examples.zh: 写文章要自出机杼，不要一味抄袭前人。
examples.en: In writing you should find your own voice instead of simply copying earlier authors.

story.en: The Northern Wei scholar Zu Ying said that writing must 'come from one's own loom and form a style of one's own' (文章须自出机杼，成一家风骨), rather than borrow from others.
story.zh: 祖莹语：“文章须自出机杼，成一家风骨，何能共人同生活也！”

usage.en: Predicate; used of writing, art and design. Literary and complimentary.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于文章、艺术、设计，书面语，含褒义。

natural: the cuckoo cries until it spits blood

meaning.en: Intense grief and sorrow; also a lament for a lost homeland or loved one.
meaning.zh: 传说杜鹃鸟啼叫到嘴里流血，比喻极其悲痛哀伤。

examples.zh: 读着他的绝笔诗，真让人感到杜鹃啼血般的悲痛。
examples.en: Reading his last poem, one feels a grief like the cuckoo crying blood.

examples.zh: 诗人以杜鹃啼血寄托对故国的思念。
examples.en: The poet used the bleeding cuckoo to express his longing for his lost homeland.

examples.zh: 母亲在灵前哭得杜鹃啼血，听者无不落泪。
examples.en: The mother wept at the coffin as if crying blood, and everyone who heard her shed tears.

usage.en: Mostly literary; used as predicate or as an image in poems and elegies.
usage.zh: 多用于书面语，作谓语，或在诗文、悼词中作比喻。

literal: road · on the road · with · eyes

meaning.en: People dare not speak and can only exchange glances on the road; a sign of harsh, tyrannical rule.
meaning.zh: 路上相遇，不敢交谈，只能以目光示意，形容统治者暴虐、人民不敢说话。

examples.zh: 暴君当政时，百姓道路以目，不敢议论朝政。
examples.en: Under the tyrant the people dared not speak and only exchanged glances in the streets.

examples.zh: 在高压统治下，人们道路以目，整个城市死气沉沉。
examples.en: Under heavy repression people kept silent, and the whole city seemed lifeless.

examples.zh: 历史告诉我们，道路以目的社会是不会长久的。
examples.en: History tells us that a society where people dare not speak cannot last.

story.en: Under King Li of Zhou, who silenced criticism, the Guoyu records that the people 'dared not speak and could only exchange glances on the road' (国人莫敢言，道路以目).
story.zh: 《国语·周语上》记周厉王暴虐，禁止人们议论：“国人莫敢言，道路以目。”

usage.en: Predicate; criticises oppressive rule and suppression of speech.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于批评暴政与压制言论。

meaning.en: To stand alone against the views of everyone else and hold one's own position.
meaning.zh: 一个人排除众人的不同意见，坚持自己的主张。

examples.zh: 总经理独排众议，坚持推行这项改革。
examples.en: The general manager overrode all objections and pushed this reform through.

examples.zh: 他独排众议，认为这座老桥应该保留。
examples.en: Going against everyone else, he held that the old bridge should stay.

examples.zh: 当年她独排众议，选择了这条冷门的研究路线。
examples.en: Back then she defied the consensus and chose this unfashionable line of research.

usage.en: Predicate; neutral to positive, depending on whether the stand proves right.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，褒贬视情况而定，常带肯定色彩。

literal: give up · self · for · public good
natural: sacrifice oneself for the public good

meaning.en: To give up personal interests for the sake of the public or the collective.
meaning.zh: 舍弃个人利益，为了集体或大众的利益。

examples.zh: 老村长舍己为公，把自家的田让出来修了水渠。
examples.en: The old village head gave up his own field to build the irrigation channel.

examples.zh: 消防员舍己为公的精神感动了全城。
examples.en: The firefighters' spirit of self-sacrifice moved the whole city.

examples.zh: 他舍己为公，从不计较个人得失。
examples.en: He puts the common good first and never counts his own gains and losses.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; commendatory, formal.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，含褒义，较正式。

meaning.en: To buy up what others reject; to take a different course from the crowd, often to profit.
meaning.zh: 别人抛弃的东西我收取，指见解与众不同、反其道而行。

examples.zh: 他奉行人弃我取的原则，在低谷时买下了这家公司。
examples.en: Following the rule of taking what others discard, he bought this company at its low point.

examples.zh: 人弃我取，这种逆向投资往往需要很大的勇气。
examples.en: Taking what others discard, this kind of contrarian investing often takes great courage.

examples.zh: 别人都放弃的项目，他人弃我取，竟然做成了。
examples.en: He took on the project everyone else gave up, and made it work.

story.en: In the biography of merchants, the businessman Bai Gui is said to have followed the rule 'I take what others discard, and give what others take' (人弃我取，人取我与).
story.zh: 《史记·货殖列传》记白圭经商的原则：“人弃我取，人取我与。”

usage.en: Predicate or clause; common in business and investing, often paired with 人取我与.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或分句，常用于经商、投资，常与“人取我与”连用。

meaning.en: Looking upright and principled outwardly, but being smooth and accommodating in reality.
meaning.zh: 外表方正，内心圆滑，指表面正直而实际处世圆滑。

examples.zh: 他看似外方内圆，其实比谁都会见风使舵。
examples.en: He looks upright but is really slippery and trims his sails better than anyone.

examples.zh: 此人外方内圆，很难让人信任。
examples.en: This man is principled only on the surface and is hard to trust.

examples.zh: 外方内圆的处世方式，在职场上并不少见。
examples.en: Being upright outside and flexible inside is not rare in the workplace.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; note it is NOT the same as 外圆内方 (smooth outside, principled inside), which is its opposite and is praise.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；注意与褒义的“外圆内方”意思相反。

meaning.en: The most important and obvious items among many.
meaning.zh: 明显的、重要的方面；指众多事物中最突出的几项。

examples.zh: 这本书讲了许多问题，这里只谈荦荦大者。
examples.en: The book covers many questions; here I only discuss the major ones.

examples.zh: 他在报告里只列举了荦荦大者，细节另附说明。
examples.en: In the report he listed only the key points, with details attached separately.

examples.zh: 这座古城名胜很多，荦荦大者有三处。
examples.en: The old city has many sights, and the most outstanding are three.

usage.en: Used as object or subject; mainly in formal writing, often after 举 or 言.
usage.zh: 作宾语或主语；多见于书面语，常与“举”“言”等搭配。

natural: bores into the heart and pierces the bone

meaning.en: Pain or cold so intense that it seems to pierce the heart and bones.
meaning.zh: 形容疼痛或寒冷极其剧烈，深入心骨。

examples.zh: 伤口的疼痛钻心刺骨，他咬紧牙关一声不吭。
examples.en: The wound hurt excruciatingly, but he clenched his teeth and said nothing.

examples.zh: 北风钻心刺骨，行人都裹紧了大衣。
examples.en: The north wind cut to the bone and passers-by wrapped their coats tight.

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，她感到一阵钻心刺骨的痛。
examples.en: On hearing the news she felt a piercing pain.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; for physical pain, cold or deep distress.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，形容身体的痛、寒冷或内心的痛苦。

meaning.en: To admit something frankly without trying to hide it.
meaning.zh: 坦率地承认，毫不隐瞒。

examples.zh: 面对记者的提问，他对自己的错误直认不讳。
examples.en: Asked by reporters, he admitted his mistakes without concealment.

examples.zh: 犯罪嫌疑人对作案经过直认不讳。
examples.en: The suspect frankly admitted how the crime was committed.

examples.zh: 她直认不讳，当初的决定确实是个失误。
examples.en: She admitted openly that the original decision had indeed been a mistake.

usage.en: Predicate, often followed by an object clause; formal, common in news and legal contexts.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，后常带宾语或小句；较正式，常见于新闻与法律语境。

meaning.en: Unofficial histories and anecdotal writings, as opposed to the formal state histories.
meaning.zh: 指记载民间传闻、轶事的非正式史书和笔记小说。

examples.zh: 这个故事多半出自稗官野史，不能当作信史。
examples.en: This story mostly comes from unofficial chronicles and cannot be taken as reliable history.

examples.zh: 他爱读稗官野史，对历史上的轶闻如数家珍。
examples.en: He loves reading anecdotal histories and knows the historical gossip by heart.

examples.zh: 稗官野史虽然不够严谨，却保留了不少生动的细节。
examples.en: Though unrigorous, unofficial histories preserve many lively details.

usage.en: Noun; used when discussing the reliability of sources.
usage.zh: 名词；常在讨论史料可靠性时使用。

meaning.en: To speak in a harsh, rude and angry manner.
meaning.zh: 说话声音粗暴，态度凶恶。

examples.zh: 他恶声恶气地问：“你到底干不干？”
examples.en: 'Are you going to do it or not?' he demanded in a nasty tone.

examples.zh: 有话好好说，别对孩子恶声恶气的。
examples.en: Say it nicely; don't snap at the child like that.

examples.zh: 售货员恶声恶气，顾客转身就走了。
examples.en: The shop assistant was rude and harsh, and the customer simply turned and left.

usage.en: Usually adverbial before 地 + a speech verb, or as predicate; disapproving, colloquial.
usage.zh: 常作状语（后加“地”和说话动词）或谓语；带贬义，口语。

meaning.en: May joy last for ever; a traditional wish for lasting happiness.
meaning.zh: 长久快乐，没有尽头；多作祝福语。

examples.zh: 瓦当上刻着“长乐未央”四个字，寓意吉祥。
examples.en: The roof tile bears the four characters for 'joy without end', an auspicious wish.

examples.zh: 新年到来，愿大家长乐未央。
examples.en: As the new year comes, may everyone enjoy lasting happiness.

examples.zh: 这方砚台刻有“长乐未央”，是汉代的遗物。
examples.en: This inkstone is carved with 'lasting joy', a relic from the Han dynasty.

usage.en: Used as a blessing or on inscriptions, tiles and mirrors; literary and auspicious.
usage.zh: 多用作祝福语，或见于瓦当、铜镜等铭文；书面、吉祥语。

natural: take something out of one's bag

meaning.en: As easy as taking something from one's own bag; a task that is certain to succeed with no effort.
meaning.zh: 像从口袋里拿东西一样容易，比喻事情很容易办到。

examples.zh: 对他来说，赢下这场比赛简直是囊中取物。
examples.en: For him, winning this match is simply a walkover.

examples.zh: 这个项目已经谈得差不多了，拿下来如同囊中取物。
examples.en: The project is almost settled, and winning it will be like picking it from a bag.

examples.zh: 别以为囊中取物那么简单，对手也很强。
examples.en: Don't think it is as easy as taking something from a bag; the opponent is strong too.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; informal-neutral, can be slightly overconfident.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语；中性偏口语，有时带有轻敌的意味。

natural: improve one's virtue and cultivate one's work

meaning.en: To keep improving one's moral character and one's studies or career.
meaning.zh: 提高品德，建树功业或学业。

examples.zh: 校训要求学生进德修业，做有用之人。
examples.en: The school motto asks students to build character and knowledge and become useful people.

examples.zh: 先贤教导我们要进德修业，不可荒废时日。
examples.en: The sages taught us to improve our virtue and work, and not waste our days.

examples.zh: 他一生进德修业，受到学生们的敬重。
examples.en: He spent his life improving his character and work and was respected by his students.

story.en: The Wenyan commentary on the Qian hexagram says 'The gentleman advances in virtue and cultivates his work' (君子进德修业).

usage.en: Predicate; formal, often seen in mottos and speeches.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；较正式，常见于校训、演讲。

natural: restrain oneself and act with care

meaning.en: To discipline oneself and act with caution.
meaning.zh: 约束自己，谨慎行事。

examples.zh: 身为公职人员，应当克己慎行，接受监督。
examples.en: As a public servant one should be self-disciplined and careful, and accept oversight.

examples.zh: 他克己慎行，从不在小事上马虎。
examples.en: He keeps himself in check and acts carefully, never careless even in small things.

examples.zh: 父亲常教导我们要克己慎行。
examples.en: Father often taught us to restrain ourselves and act with care.

usage.en: Predicate; formal, moralising.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；较正式，有劝诫意味。

meaning.en: To heave a long, deep sigh out of feeling or regret.
meaning.zh: 深深地叹一口长气，形容感慨或惋惜。

examples.zh: 看着旧照片，他喟然长叹，往事如在眼前。
examples.en: Looking at the old photos he sighed deeply, the past seeming to stand before him.

examples.zh: 老人望着荒芜的田地，喟然长叹。
examples.en: The old man gazed at the wasted fields and gave a long sigh.

examples.zh: 听完这番话，她喟然长叹，不再言语。
examples.en: After hearing this she sighed long and said no more.

usage.en: Predicate, mostly in narrative; literary.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于叙事；书面语。

natural: keep what is full and safeguard peace

meaning.en: To keep one's success and prosperity safe by staying cautious and not overreaching.
meaning.zh: 在事业兴盛、富足时小心谨慎，以保持安定繁荣。

examples.zh: 企业越是顺利，越要持盈保泰，防止盲目扩张。
examples.en: The smoother a business runs, the more it must stay prudent and avoid blind expansion.

examples.zh: 他深知持盈保泰的道理，从不张扬。
examples.en: He knows well how to preserve prosperity and never shows off.

examples.zh: 国家富强之后，更须持盈保泰。
examples.en: After a country becomes prosperous it must be all the more careful to keep it safe.

usage.en: Predicate; formal and slightly archaic; used in advice.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；较正式，略带古意，用于劝诫。

natural: the four seasons and eight seasonal junctures

meaning.en: All the seasons and festivals of the year; at all times of the year.
meaning.zh: 指一年四季和各个节气、节日，泛指一年到头。

examples.zh: 四时八节，他都不忘给老母亲寄东西。
examples.en: Through every season and festival he never forgot to send things to his old mother.

examples.zh: 这里四时八节都有鲜花盛开。
examples.en: Here flowers bloom in every season and at every festival.

examples.zh: 四时八节的习俗，反映了农耕社会的生活。
examples.en: The customs of the seasons and festivals reflect life in a farming society.

usage.en: Mostly adverbial or attributive; the eight 节 are the start of each season, the equinoxes and the solstices.
usage.zh: 多作状语、定语；“八节”指立春、春分、立夏、夏至、立秋、秋分、立冬、冬至。

natural: people and guests coming and going

meaning.en: A constant stream of visitors, so the place is lively and busy.
meaning.zh: 来来往往的客人很多，形容很热闹。

examples.zh: 春节期间，老宅里人来客往，十分热闹。
examples.en: During the Spring Festival the old house buzzed with visitors.

examples.zh: 他的小店人来客往，生意红火。
examples.en: His little shop is full of comings and goings and business is brisk.

examples.zh: 医生办公室一整天人来客往，没有片刻清静。
examples.en: The doctor's office saw a stream of visitors all day, without a moment's peace.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; casual and lively.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；口语色彩，气氛热闹。

meaning.en: To escape from great danger with one's life.
meaning.zh: 从老虎嘴里逃出来，比喻脱离极危险的境地。

equivalents: escape by the skin of one's teeth

examples.zh: 矿工们虎口逃生，全部安全升井。
examples.en: The miners escaped death and all came safely to the surface.

examples.zh: 他在地震中虎口逃生，至今心有余悸。
examples.en: He had a narrow escape in the earthquake and still feels shaken.

examples.zh: 这次虎口逃生的经历让她懂得了生命的可贵。
examples.en: The experience of escaping from deadly danger taught her how precious life is.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; used for accidents, disasters, crime.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，用于事故、灾难、犯罪等场合。

meaning.en: To lack a sense of the larger interests and proper conduct; to be short-sighted and unreasonable.
meaning.zh: 不懂得从大局着想，不明白事理。

examples.zh: 为了一点小事争吵，未免太不识大体了。
examples.en: To quarrel over a trifle is rather short-sighted.

examples.zh: 他不识大体，在会议上公开顶撞领导。
examples.en: He lacks a sense of proportion and openly contradicted the leader at the meeting.

examples.zh: 大家都在帮忙，你却闹情绪，真是不识大体。
examples.en: Everyone is helping out and you are sulking; you really don't see the bigger picture.

usage.en: Predicate; critical; fairly formal, but common in daily speech.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；批评口气，书面口语都常用。

meaning.en: To have made the greatest contribution among many.
meaning.zh: 在功劳中位居前列，贡献最大。

equivalents: deserve the lion's share of the credit

examples.zh: 这次比赛获胜，教练居功厥伟。
examples.en: The coach deserves the greatest credit for winning this match.

examples.zh: 在项目攻关中，几位年轻工程师居功厥伟。
examples.en: In tackling the project, several young engineers contributed the most.

examples.zh: 她为公司发展居功厥伟，理应获得表彰。
examples.en: She has contributed enormously to the company's growth and deserves recognition.

usage.en: Predicate; formal praise, common in news and speeches. 厥 = 其 (his/its).
usage.zh: 多作谓语；正式褒扬语，常见于新闻、讲话。“厥”意为“其”。

natural: an order as firm as a mountain

meaning.en: Once an order is given it is as unshakable as a mountain; it must be carried out.
meaning.zh: 命令一经发出，就像山一样不可动摇，必须执行。

equivalents: orders are not to be questioned

examples.zh: 军队令出如山，谁也不敢违抗。
examples.en: In the army orders stand like mountains, and nobody dares to disobey.

examples.zh: 队长令出如山，大家立即行动起来。
examples.en: The captain's orders carry weight, and everyone moved at once.

examples.zh: 公司规定令出如山，不得拖延。
examples.en: Company rules are firm as a mountain, with no delay allowed.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 军令如山; authority and discipline.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；常与“军令如山”相近使用，强调权威与纪律。

literal: order · issued · must · be carried out
natural: orders issued must be carried out

meaning.en: Once an order is issued it must be carried out without fail.
meaning.zh: 命令一旦发出，就必须执行。

examples.zh: 新规定令出必行，违者一律处理。
examples.en: The new rule must be carried out, and violators will be dealt with.

examples.zh: 这支队伍纪律严明，令出必行。
examples.en: This team is strictly disciplined and orders are always carried out.

examples.zh: 政府强调令出必行，杜绝推诿拖延。
examples.en: The government stressed that orders must be implemented and passing the buck stopped.

usage.en: Predicate; formal, used for discipline and government work; close to 令行禁止.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；较正式，用于纪律和行政工作，与“令行禁止”相近。

literal: lead · wife · take along · young children

meaning.en: To travel or move house with one's whole family, wife and young children in tow.
meaning.zh: 带着妻子和儿女，指举家迁移或出行。

equivalents: with the whole family in tow
taking the wife and kids along

examples.zh: 灾荒之年，许多人挈妇将雏，离乡逃难。
examples.en: In the famine year many people left home with their wives and children.

examples.zh: 他挈妇将雏来到南方谋生。
examples.en: He came south to make a living with his wife and children in tow.

examples.zh: 车站里挈妇将雏的旅客挤满了候车室。
examples.en: The waiting room was full of travellers with their families in tow.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; literary, describes hardship of moving a family.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；书面语，常含奔波辛苦之意。
